content.value: A tightly stretched string with fixed end points $x = 0$ and $x = 5$ cm is initially at rest in it's 18 equilibrium position. If each of it's points is given a velocity $u _ { t } ( x , 0 ) = 2 x ( 1 - x )$ , find the displacement of the string at any distance x from one end at any time t.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
